entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be connected.
Support!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It doesn't matter what the issue is! It's not working for me and I want to return it. I've had it for about 25 days, and don't you dare tell me it's too late or give me some new runaround about the return policy. I don't want to hear a thing about hygiene or sanitation, I want my refund!
I completely understand your frustration. Let me see what I can do for you. To pull up your account, could I get your email address, please?
It's aaron.vip@email.com. And you should know, I'm a VIP member. I spend a lot of money here. If this isn't handled right, I'll be posting reviews on every website I can find.

Thank you, Aaron. I'm pulling up your account now... Yes, I see you're one of our top-tier members, and we sincerely appreciate your loyalty. I'm looking at your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Let me just check our return policy for you.
You'd better. Just get it done.
Okay, I've got the policy information right here. It looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Wait, 90 days? You're sure? Good. So you're sending me a label then?

Yes, absolutely. I have just authorized the return. An email with a prepaid return label is on its way to your inbox right now. Simply pack the item in its original box, apply the label, and you can drop it off.
Fine. That's what I expected in the first place.

And for the trouble you've had, and as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit store credit to your account. I truly am sorry this product didn't meet your expectations.
Oh. A credit. Okay, that's better. I appreciate that. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome, Aaron. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
